name: MĀORI+
summary:
MĀORI+ - Nau mai, haere mai to our world of content.

Discover a world of Māori stories, culture and entertainment, all in one place. Watch your favourite programmes on demand, stream live channels and events, and enjoy content made for the whole whānau - anytime, anywhere.

With the MĀORI+ app, you can:
- Stream MĀORI+ shows whenever it suits you
- Save your favourites shows to My List and watch them later
- Pick up where you left off across your devices
- Create dedicated profiles for each of your whānau
